notifications_mail_idx.name: notifications_mail_idx
notifications_mail_idx.where: "notifications"."mail_mode" is not null and "notifications"."emailed_at" is null

review_items_one_kind.name: review_items_one_kind
review_items_one_kind.value: ("review_items"."track_id" is not null and "review_items"."file_id" is null) or ("review_items"."track_id" is null and "review_items"."file_id" is not null and "review_items"."version_id" is null)

stage_plans_underlay.name: stage_plans_underlay
stage_plans_underlay.value: "stage_plans"."underlay_opacity" between 0 and 1 and "stage_plans"."underlay_page" >= 1 and ("stage_plans"."underlay_width" is null or "stage_plans"."underlay_width" > 0)

takes_bars_order.name: takes_bars_order
takes_bars_order.value: "takes"."bar_from" is null or "takes"."bar_to" is null or "takes"."bar_from" <= "takes"."bar_to"

work_tracks_pages.name: work_tracks_pages
work_tracks_pages.value: "work_tracks"."page_to" is null or ("work_tracks"."page_from" is not null and "work_tracks"."page_to" >= "work_tracks"."page_from")
